scientific_integrity: Proof uses exact axial differentiation and tetrahedral equivariance; arithmetic checker is corroborative and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Local near the centroid; not a global classification of all interior projection points. The claimed coefficient depends on the stated unit normalization and edge-square norm; original priority is not independently audited.
title: Sharp local four-pedal rigidity at the centre of a regular tetrahedron
